capabilities: split a note into slides on --- separators
pick colour themes per deck or per slide from a side panel
present full-screen in Obsidian or in a browser
auto-fit Mermaid diagrams and code blocks to the slide
export the deck as a landscape PDF or HTML file
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the browser preview runs a localhost server only and sends nothing over the internet.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a note into styled full-screen slides or present and share them outside the vault.
summary: Slide presenter that turns notes into full-screen slides split on ---, with per-slide colours and themes, a browser preview, and PDF/HTML export.
